items.text: METALS ABOVE HYDROGEN IN THE REACTI METALS ABOVE HYDROGEN IN THE REACTIVITY SERIES

items.label: text
items.text: Metals above hydrogen in the reactivity series react with water (or steam) to produce hydrogen.

items.label: text
items.text: If the metal reacts with cold water, the metal hydroxide and hydrogen are formed. metal + cold water → metal hydroxide + hydrogen

items.label: text
items.text: If the metal reacts with steam, the metal oxide and hydrogen are formed.

items.label: text
items.text: metal + steam → metal oxide + hydrogen

items.label: text
items.text: As you move down the reactivity series, the reactions become less and less vigorous.
